events.name: 36th Annual Fountain City Classic
events.info: Experience Classic Magic. Prepare for the ultimate showdown at the 36th Annual Fountain City Classic. Join us on Saturday November 7 2026 at 2:00 PM at the historic A.J. McClung Memorial Stadium in Columbus GA for an electrifying celebration of sportsmanship and tradition. Witness the clash of two HBCU football giants Albany State University Golden Rams and Fort Valley State University Wildcats on the historic turf. Get ready for heart-stopping plays enthusiastic fans and an unparalleled tailgate experience in southwest Georgia. This classic promises a riveting display of skill determination and camaraderie. Do not miss the most anticipated event of the year. PoundClassicMagicIsBack PoundFCC36 A student ID is required for students aged 17 through 22. All student tickets are subject to ID verification at the gate. Clear bag policy will be enforced. For more details visit fountaincityclassic.com.

Box Office Hours for Saturday game days begin at 1:00 PM Contact the Columbus River Dragons for Season tickets, group tickets or for certain ticket offers at 706-507-4625 A clear bag policy is enforced at the Columbus Civic Center. Please visit https://www.columbusga.gov/civiccenter-2/Plan-Your-Visit/Clear-Bag-Policy for detailed information Columbus Civic Center is a cashless and ticketless venue We accept VISA, Mastercard and Discover Tickets will be delivered electronically via email or text

events.name: MVP Court Pass (Check In By 12:30 PM)
events.info: THIS IS AN OPTIONAL UPGRADE. TICKET TO THE MAIN EVENT IS ALSO REQUIRED. Get closer than courtside with the MVP Court Pass! Join the Pre-Game Fan Tunnel to welcome the Harlem Globetrotters to the floor, step into the Pre-Game Huddle, warm up with the team, and watch the famous Globetrotters Magic Circle from just feet away. This is MVP access on another level, and the perfect way to make a memory you'll talk about for years to come. With just 16 passes per game, this is the most exclusive 20 minutes in the arena. Check in at the announcer's table 30 mins prior to the game start. Late arrivals will not be refunded. All participants must have their own MVP Court Pass - no exceptions. Children under 10 must be with an adult who also has an MVP Court Pass. Soft or rubber-soled shoes required. This premium upgrade is not included with your game ticket. Don't miss your chance to be part of the Rivalry as an MVP!

events.name: Ultimate Fan Pass: 30-min Exclusive On-Court Access from 11:30AM-12PM
events.info: THIS IS AN OPTIONAL UPGRADE. TICKET TO MAIN EVENT ALSO REQUIRED. Get closer to the action with the all-new Ultimate Fan Pass - a limited-capacity, 30-minute pregame on-court experience featuring the Harlem Globetrotters and their Rivals. Be first through the doors and first on the court, where you get exclusive access up close with the players, learn trick shots from the pros, get one-of-a-kind photos, and kick off your own tip-off party before the rest of the crowd arrives. Ultimate Fan Pass guests also get first access to the merchandise stands before the lines form. A separate game ticket is required and is not included with this experience. Minors must be accompanied by an adult who also holds an Ultimate Fan Pass. Soft- or rubber-soled shoes are required on court. The on-court experience begins 90 minutes before game time. Late arrivals may miss some or all of the experience and are not eligible for refunds.
